name: Pipeliners - Company Profile
body:
> Profile · Pipeliners · 2026-10-01

Merged from three source files: `Pipeliners Company Master Profile.md` (the full single source of truth, built 2026-10-01), its PDF export `Pipeliners Company Master Profile.pdf` (same content), and `Pipeliners Company Profile - Simple.md` (the plain-language one-page version). Status labels in the source: verified by Scott/Jake/Kim, present but unconfirmed, or not on record (ask Scott).

# Basics
- **Name:** Pipeliners. Older pages say "Pipeliners USA"; new copy says "Pipeliners" only.
- **Website:** https://pipelinersusa.com/
- **Business type:** specialist trenchless contractor (pipe lining and restoration), not a general plumber.
- **Owner:** Scott Vincent. Jake (field lead) approves service claims. New blog author is Jake Shaker.
- **Office:** 633 W 2nd Ave, Mesa, AZ 85210.
- **License:** Arizona ROC #362960 (not reconfirmed as current by Scott).
- **Service area:** Phoenix metro plus Pinal County, 37 city pages (28 Maricopa County, 9 Pinal).
- **Phone for copy and meta:** (480) 535-6503. GBP number (480) 447-5345. Pool numbers such as (480) 770-3098 and (623) 286-3774 are GoHighLevel call tracking by design. (480) 969-7978 on Birdeye and the Ace DuraFlo list is unknown.
- **Hours:** GBP lists 24 hours, but do not advertise 24/7 or emergency service. The crew is booked out a couple of months.

# Services
- **Core:** trenchless drain and sewer relining (CIPP, epoxy liner, UV LED cured), ePIPE water line restoration (NSF/ANSI 61 coating), hydro jetting ("we don't jet blind").
- **Supporting:** sewer camera inspection (always first), leak detection (pressure, acoustic, thermal), slab leak repair by lining the pipe, root intrusion repair, cast iron/clay/Orangeburg restoration, permits pulled.
- **Not offered:** full repipes, manhole lining, gas lines, pipe bursting, Kitec, water heaters and fixtures, HVAC, pigging. Commercial scope is unconfirmed.
- **Priority to promote:** drain lining and ePIPE (the paid landing pages). Hydro jetting is the entry service.

# Customers and goals
- Homeowners in older Valley homes (Phoenix clay/Orangeburg, Mesa 1950s-70s and Sun City 1960-78 cast iron, copper pinhole leaks, slab homes), retirees in age-restricted communities, large-lot owners, realtors and buyers, and (pending Scott) property managers and HOAs.
- Call triggers: repeat backups, sewer smell, a camera finding, a water bill spike, a slab leak, a home sale, a monsoon backup, a shocking dig-and-replace quote.
- Customer goals: a lasting fix with a written warranty, no digging, spend less than dig-and-replace, understand the cause, stay in the home.

# Approved claims
- 20-year drain-lining warranty and 10-year ePIPE warranty, written and transferable.
- Drain liners 50+ years, ePIPE 75+ years.
- Up to 30% savings versus dig-and-replace.
- NSF/ANSI 61 coating, camera first, pressure/acoustic/thermal leak locating, slab leak repair by lining, permits pulled, "most jobs take a couple of days".

# Never claim
24/7 or emergency, same day, full repipes, manhole lining, gas, pipe bursting, Kitec, any price in new copy, "cheapest", "#1", "best", "lifetime warranty", "guaranteed", financing. Unverified and not to repeat: "only ePIPE installer in the state", "licensed ePIPE partners", "All Work Guaranteed", "insured", "expansive soil".

# Brand voice
Knowledgeable, honest, calm, plain homeowner English (grade 7-8). Use "lining the pipe", "relining", "no-dig". Avoid "pipe lining"/"pipelining" as a noun, "pipeline", "pigging", "rooter", em dashes and prices.

# Local identity
- Primary city Mesa (HQ). Core metro cities: Phoenix, Mesa, Tempe, Chandler, Gilbert, Scottsdale, Glendale, Peoria, Buckeye, Florence.
- Verified local conditions: very hard water (City of Phoenix 2025 report, 172-302 ppm), heat and caliche, monsoon season July-September, subsidence and earth fissures in Pinal County, pipe age by build era, tree roots, long runs and septic on large lots, named utilities (EPCOR, Global Water, Liberty Utilities, Fountain Hills Sanitary District).
- Fort McDowell and Sacaton are tribal nations; Laveen is in the City of Phoenix; San Tan Valley is unincorporated. Always put "AZ" in city titles (wrong-state traffic exists).

# SEO identity (from the profile)
- Key keywords include trenchless sewer repair (4,400), no dig sewer repair (5,400), sewer camera inspection (8,100 / KD 18), sewer cleanout (6,600 / KD 14), main sewer line clog (1,900 / KD 21), clay sewer pipe (1,223 / KD 21), relining cast iron pipe (590 / KD 7).
- Cannibalization watch: the two lining-vs-replacement posts and the three CIPP posts. Blogs must not target terms owned by service pages (trenchless pipe repair, trenchless sewer repair, hydro jetting, leak detection).
- AI visibility baseline 44/100 (Sep 29). Reviews: about 4.99 average from about 123-127 Google reviews.

# Sales snapshot
63 leads in 30 days to Sep 29 (Keystone CRM), 8 booked; GBP is the best channel (23). Sample booked jobs roughly $2,200 to $5,900. 2026 YTD (Aug 19 meeting): about $14k ads spend, $252k estimates, $57k closed.

# Open questions for Scott
Founding year, ROC status and insurance, average job value and sales cycle, financing, commercial scope, 2-3 real job photos, owner of (480) 969-7978, the "only ePIPE installer" claim, the correct GBP service list.
